properties.text: The Ukrainian General Staff reported that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Rubikon Center for Advanced Unmanned Technologies manpower concentration near Kamyanka, Zaporizhia Oblast (roughly 31 kilometers from the frontline) on October 22 or overnight on October 22 to 23.[63] Neither Russian nor Ukrainian sources reported ground activity in the Kherson direction on October 23.

ISW continues to assess that Russian sources are engaging in a sophisticated cognitive warfare effort that aims to portray Ukrainian forces as on the brink of collapse and assert that Russian forces are continuing to advance across the frontline.[44] Russian forces recently conducted an infiltration mission in western Zaporizhia Oblast.
Ukrainian forces advanced east of Sumy City, and Russian forces advanced south of Orikhiv.
